verdict.rationale: Terminal emulators can plausibly ship scripting, triggers or background automation, so this axis applies to Alacritty. The evidence shows only the `alacritty msg` IPC and config options such as env vars and working directory. These are building blocks a user could script around, not a documented feature for setting up automations that run autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
